t2.thesis: TXN enters earnings after a strong run, with a large implied move of about 7.2% and estimates already revised up, so the reaction is close to a coin flip with no clear edge.
reasons: The semis cluster base rate (47.9%) sits below the overall rate (54%), which offsets the generally positive earnings-drift base rate.
Estimates have risen sharply (90-day EPS revision +12%, consensus $2.43 versus $1.48 a year ago), so the bar is high after a 63% 12-month gain.
The stock is 15% below its 52w high, with a recent 5-day dip of -2.7%, which leaves some room for a relief move.
Past reactions are mixed (last 4 win rate 50%), including a drop after a +10% EPS beat in July, which shows how much guidance drives the reaction.
The implied move of 7.2% is large, but the call/put skew is balanced, so options give no directional signal.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance versus consensus, especially industrial and data center strength, plus the capex and free cash flow outlook.

prior.from: I3 semis cluster t0_hit 0.479 blended with AMC session 0.538 and overall 0.542; semis is the closest cluster for TXN, so I settle near 0.51

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. I don't have information on how TXN's stock moved after its 2026-10-21 earnings report, since that falls after my knowledge cutoff.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved from 0.51 to 0.50, a downward nudge of about 0.01 because expectations look elevated after the revisions and the rally; no directional evidence offsets it.

theses.expected: Stock rises on guidance above consensus
theses.mechanism: Industrial and data center recovery plus 300mm cost benefits lift margins and the outlook
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue guidance midpoint comes in below consensus or gross margin guidance disappoints

theses.expected: Stock falls despite an EPS beat
theses.mechanism: The high bar after a 63% annual run and upward revisions means a beat is priced in, as in July
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is clearly strong and the stock opens higher

theses.expected: Muted or mixed move with an opening gap that fades
theses.mechanism: Peer read-throughs from Lam Research and the wider chip sector dominate the opening
theses.wrong_if: TXN gaps beyond the implied 7% move in either direction

key_observations: Q4 revenue guidance midpoint versus consensus
Gross margin and the opex/capex outlook
Free cash flow trajectory and the Silicon Labs deal funding
Lam Research results at the same time and the sector tone
